storage.title: Home Assistant Context storage
storage.label: Store
storage.warning: Some Home Assistant nodes save enabled states, last entity values, and hidden issue settings so they can restore them after a Node-RED restart. Choose a persistent context store to preserve these values; otherwise, they reset on restart.
storage.persistence_warning: Some Home Assistant nodes rely on saved enabled states and last entity values to restore their behavior after Node-RED restarts. Choose a persistent context store to preserve these values; otherwise, they reset.
storage.persistent_warning: The selected local filesystem store preserves saved Home Assistant node data across restarts. Writes may still be buffered and delayed.
storage.context_docs: Home Assistant context storage setup and example
storage.waiting: Waiting for a Home Assistant node before storage can be initialized.
storage.failed: Storage could not be initialized. Select an available store and restart Node-RED; data could not be copied from the previous store.
storage.confirm: Copy current Home Assistant data to this store? Existing Home Assistant data in the destination will be replaced.
storage.confirm_persistence: I confirm this custom context store persists data across Node-RED restarts.
storage.confirm_persistence_help: Only confirm this if the store or its provider guarantees data is retained across restarts. Memory stores cannot be marked persistent.
storage.failed_save: Unable to change the context store.
storage.migration_completed: Existing Home Assistant data was imported into the configured persistent context store.
storage.migration_pending: Only Home Assistant integration data is affected. It was loaded into a context store that may not survive a restart. The lowdb backup is retained, and migration will retry after restart until a persistent filesystem store is selected.
